name: Phoenix Mars Lander
summary: Phoenix landed in the Martian arctic to study water ice beneath the surface soil.
hook: I dug into the arctic soils of northern Mars and verified subsurface water ice in 2008.
how_it_worked: Stationary lander equipped with a 2.35-meter robotic trenching arm and thermal oven analyzers.
science: Exposed chunks of bright white water ice that sublimated into vapor over several days.

facts.text: Phoenix detected perchlorate salts in the soil, which lower the freezing point of water.
Mission ended when solar panels lost sunlight during the onset of the deep northern Martian winter.
